<span class="eyebrow">Conferences · Invited Sessions · Scientific Committees</span>

<p class="lede">More than two decades of contributions to national and international conferences — from COMPSTAT 2002 in Berlin to ENBIS 2026 in Florence — on bibliometrics and science mapping, tree-based and explainable machine learning, text analysis, and health and tourism analytics.</p>

Active participant in numerous national and international conferences — DSSR, SDS, ASA, COMPSTAT, IFCS, CLADAG, JADT, ECDA, ENBIS, and CMStatistics — where I have presented research contributions related to bibliometric analysis, classification methods, explainable machine learning, and methodological innovation in the social sciences. Invited seminars and doctoral lectures are listed on the [Teaching](teaching.qmd) page.

## Scientific Committees

Member of the scientific or organising committees of major conferences, including **JADT 2022** and **JADT 2026**, the **Data Science in Social Research (DSSR)** conferences, and several editions of the **Italian Statistics Society (SIS)** meetings.

- **2026** · Programme Committee, “18th International Conference on Statistical Analysis of Textual Data” (JADT 2026), Palermo, 8–10 July 2026.
- **2025** · Scientific Committee, “The Future of Sustainability” (SIS DIAS), Bari.
- **2025** · Scientific Committee, “5th International Conference on Data Science in Social Research” (DSSR2025), Pescara.
- **2024** · Scientific Committee, “4th International Conference on Data Science in Social Research” (DSSR2024), Naples.
- **2022** · Programme Committee, “16th International Conference on Statistical Analysis of Textual Data” (JADT 2022), Naples.
- **2021** · Programme Committee, “Small Area Estimation: Big4Small” (SAE 2021), Naples.
- **2019** · Scientific Committee, “3rd International Conference on Data Science in Social Research” (DSSR 2019), Milan.
- **2015** · Programme Committee, “Correspondence Analysis and Related Methods Conference” (CARME2015), Naples.
